description: Source code implementing kqueue-based event handling for Redis, including creation, resizing, adding, deleting, and polling events.

methods.name: aeApiCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes the kqueue event API state.

methods.name: aeApiFree
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the event API.

methods.name: aeApiAddEvent
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor event (read/write) to the kqueue.

methods.name: aeApiDelEvent
methods.description: Removes a file descriptor event (read/write) from the kqueue.

methods.name: aeApiPoll
methods.description: Polls for active events with optional timeout.

methods.name: aeApiName
methods.description: Returns the name of the event API ('kqueue').
